original:
गदायुद्धमभूद् घोरं भीमदुर्योधनान्तयोः ।
द्वैपायने ह्रदे तीरे धर्मन्यायविबोधकम् ॥
sanskrit:
गदायुद्धमभूद् घोरं भीमदुर्योधनान्तयोः ।
द्वैपायने ह्रदे तीरे धर्मन्यायविबोधकम् ॥
transliteration:
gadāyuddham abhūd ghoraṃ bhīmaduryodhanāntayoḥ |
dvaipāyane hrade tīre dharmanāyavibodhakam ||
translation: A fierce mace duel took place between Bhima and Duryodhana on the banks of Dvaipayana Lake, resolving the eighteen-day conflict.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: द्वैपायन सरोवर के तट पर भीम और दुर्योधन के बीच घमासान गदा युद्ध हुआ, जिससे अठारह दिवसीय महायुद्ध का निर्णय हुआ।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: द्वैपायन सरोवराच्या काठावर भीम आणि दुर्योधन यांच्यात अटीतटीचे गदायुद्ध झाले, ज्याने १८ दिवसांच्या युद्धाचा निकाल लावला.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: The fall of Duryodhana marks the destruction of the Kaurava army on the eighteenth day of Kurukshetra.

layers.author: bori
layers.content: Witnesses Balarama's judgment and the fulfillment of Bhima's solemn vow.
